cutoff.earlier_classic_benchmark_window: Separate cohort with an earlier fixed cutoff and a newly rebuilt earlier knowledge library; never score old tasks with later solutions.

task_identity_protocol.base_environment_variants: Keep aliases and variants but do not count them as independent issues.
task_identity_protocol.new_issue_primary_rule: original_issue_created_at >= T with verified pre-fix input and executable oracle
task_identity_protocol.pre_T_resolved_tasks: Historical learning when repair evidence available before T; never new-issue blind evaluation.
task_identity_protocol.pre_T_unresolved_post_T_resolved_tasks: Separate backlog analysis, not new-issue primary cohort.
task_identity_protocol.pilot: If needed, at most 20 pre-outcome stratified random qualified issues; do not select by Skill coverage or baseline performance.
task_identity_protocol.benchmark_scores: Report by original protocol; a deduplicated multi-source cohort is not an official leaderboard score.

historical_universe.scope: All created-before-T issues in target and similar projects, including every state and problem type.
historical_universe.post_T_edits_or_unrecoverable_history: Keep identity and missing-version reason, exclude unavailable later text from knowledge.

learning_contract.unit: Evidence-grounded mechanism clusters across all issue dispositions; one-to-many and many-to-one packages allowed.
learning_contract.implementation: Direct native author files -> validation -> graph/SQLite/HNSW; semantic JSON only as derived/index/audit data.
learning_contract.core: Trigger, mechanism, semantic owner, invariant, conditions, candidate operations, validation and stopping.
learning_contract.runtime_order_inheritance: Only if current semantic/data dependencies justify the same order.
learning_contract.failed_or_unknown_functional_evals: Do not mark passed or promote; keep limitations and weak-evidence disposition.
learning_contract.Pattern_support: Multiple independent project implementations with the same mechanism; aliases/copied tests are not independent support.

relevance_protocol.initial_query: public issue, environment and observed symptoms only
relevance_protocol.refined_query: current reproduction, diagnostic, state, semantic owner and base code
relevance_protocol.fallback_without_relevant_Skill: Normal current-task Agent; keep task in every arm denominator.

adaptive_guidance_contract.historical_example_view: Explicitly labelled reference; code snippets requested through bounded resources with source/version.

main_arms.knowledge: raw historical evidence with the same temporal/evidence eligibility
native Skill packages learned from all eligible own history
native Skill packages learned from all eligible similar history
native Skill packages learned from all eligible own+similar history

Workflow_guidance_mechanism_arm.shared_prefix: Same no-history public-issue reproduction/base observations, relevance decisions and frozen selected package hashes before branching.
Workflow_guidance_mechanism_arm.guidance: Existing ordered historical Workflow guidance; keep ordinary Agent reasoning, do not force literal patch transplantation.
Workflow_guidance_mechanism_arm.post_branch_policy: Separate observations/plans/patches/results; only recheck frozen packages, no divergent new package selection.
Workflow_guidance_mechanism_arm.purpose: Explicit current-task adaptation contribution; compare B4-matched versus B5, not unmatched main trajectories.

further_ablation_conditions: Same source episode IDs and same current evidence/adaptation conditions, raw versus Skill representation.
No graph expansion; keep other policies.
No semantic applicability judge; retain package/provenance/status hard gates.
Own history source-count and extraction-budget matched.
Drop Ruff or drop Pyflakes before learning/indexing/serving.
Workflow-only versus eligible Pattern packages when Pattern packages exist.

repair_repetitions.unit_of_randomization: task x replicate, randomized arm order

resource_examples_not_frozen_task_counts.full_cohort_rule: N x registered main arms x R plus separately registered matched mechanism cohort x 2 x R; both cohorts frozen before outcomes.

evaluation.primary: ValidatedResolved@1: benchmark passes plus frozen adjacent/regression checks and no leakage/tampering.
evaluation.comparable_secondary: BenchmarkResolved@1 separately by source benchmark protocol.
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm over 3 primary contrasts, or 4 if B5 is confirmatory.
evaluation.interval_and_test: Paired independent task/bug-cluster bootstrap 95% CI plus paired permutation; small pilots exploratory.
extra_metrics: offline full-history learning and online relevance/adaptation/solver costs

system_adaptation_required.requirement: Complete cursor census, comment/event history, temporal reconstruction and every-issue dispositions.
Generalize principles and conditional Actions; distinguish historical Workflow from serving authority.
Current-evidence-aware query and mechanism/owner/precondition/counterexample approval, provenance gates and fallback.
Current evidence and object/API binding; selection/composition/skipping; dependencies justified by current task.
Remove visible_test_patch from new SWE applicability inputs; evaluator artifacts stay evaluator-only.
Full multi-benchmark issue registry, temporal/duplicate classification, five/six-arm budgeted repeated runs and hidden evaluator.
Task/bug-cluster analyses, explicit adaptation evidence and harms; static serving library throughout main study.

current_verified_code_observations._render_hit: Hydrates packages directly; no implemented proof of current-action adaptation.
current_verified_code_observations._build_guidance: Has old visible_test_patch path into applicability judge; must be removed for hidden SWE protocol.
current_verified_code_observations._approved_guidance_hits: Requires applicable true and selected ID; graph related candidates still need per-action current applicability.

isolation_and_failure_policy.leakage: Affected protocol invalid; exposed cases become development; correction needs a new freeze/cohort.
isolation_and_failure_policy.formal_after_outcome_changes: New version/cohort, never mix changed libraries or cutoffs.
isolation_and_failure_policy.credentials: Runtime configured client only; no credential values in prompts/logs/manifests/Git.
isolation_and_failure_policy.public_model_pretraining_exposure: Unknown; report limits and use independent fresh follow-up cohorts.
isolation_and_failure_policy.solver_visible_inputs: Verified pre-fix public problem, corresponding base, pinned dependencies and own-arm approved guidance only.
isolation_and_failure_policy.task_tool_network: Default deny; controlled model broker, dependencies/images prepared before run; no target answers, benchmark mirrors, or post-T donor records.

Predeclared pilot and independent confirmation, paired hidden-test results.
Workflow/representation/source/graph mechanisms; second target or separate earlier-time cohort with rebuilt history.
